description: Extract positioned text items: the box, font, size and styling of every run of characters on a page. Coordinates are PDF points with a bottom-left origin. Use this for layout-aware reading; use pdf::to-markdown to just read the document.

request_schema.description: Where the PDF comes from. Exactly one of the two fields must be set.

bytes_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes, for a document with no path. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

max_items.description: Items to return before truncating. Omit for the configured default; `0` returns every item, which on a dense document is a very large response.

pages.description: 1-indexed pages to read. Omit for the whole document.

path.description: Filesystem path to the PDF. Mutually exclusive with `bytes_base64`.

request_schema.title: Request

font.description: Font name as the document names it.

height.description: Height in PDF points, approximated from the font size.

mcid.description: Marked-content id tying this item to the document's tagged structure tree, when the document has one.

strikeout.description: Recovered from vector lines through the text, not from a flag.

underline.description: Recovered from vector lines near the baseline, not from a flag.

x.description: Left edge, PDF points from the left of the page.

y.description: Baseline, PDF points from the **bottom** of the page.

oneOf.description: An image placeholder. The box is real; no pixels are decoded.
Text carrying a hyperlink; the target is in `link`.

coordinate_origin.description: Origin convention for `x` and `y`, always `pdf-points, bottom-left`. Stated on every response because a caller that assumed the other convention reads the wrong end of the page with no error. Note `pdf::extract-regions` takes boxes with a top-left origin instead.

items.description: The items, in document order, capped per `max_items`.

source.description: Source label: the file name, or `<inline>` for an in-memory document.

total_count.description: Items the document holds for the requested pages. Equal to `count` when nothing was dropped.

truncated.description: `true` when `items` stops short. Narrow `pages`, or pass `max_items: 0`.
